about: A made-up user's library: a founder who builds Pocketfold, a notes app for iPhone and Mac, with a small team. Every person and company in it is invented. 'standard' is the main library (13 binders, General, the default, among them, and 8 agents); 'small' is a subset of it and 'large' a superset. Every library has General, where the app files a moment when the model says BINDER: none.

binders.what_goes_here: The default binder: anything that doesn't belong in another one, and where things go when no binder is picked.

binders.name: Travel

binders.name: Podcast

binders.name: Climbing

binders.name: Spanish class

binders.name: Wedding

binders.name: Volunteering

binders.name: Car
